C05-FIX-02-GC.summary: Replaced error-swallowing .catch(() => undefined) calls in both removeUnusedVersion() and REMOVE_VERSION recovery with verification-enforced #executeGcDeletesUnlocked.
invariantsVerified: 1. Durable retry metadata: activeJournal retains kind='REMOVE_VERSION', state='RECOVERY_REQUIRED', narrowed unconfirmed stagedAssetKeys, committedVersionSnapshot (with per-asset sizeBytes), and failureReason until every asset is confirmed absent.

2. Absent vs genuine I/O failure distinction: pre-delete committedStat check + isStorageNotFoundError() distinguish already-absent assets (NotFoundError/ENOENT/OS-PLUG-FILE-0006) from genuine EIO/EACCES/silent-no-op delete failures across Memory, OPFS/IDB, and Capacitor Filesystem backends.
3. Journal retention until confirmed absence: post-delete committedStat confirms exists===false before clearing activeJournal to null or setting COMPLETED_INTERRUPTED_GC.
4. Accurate reclaimed storage accounting: freedBytes sums only previously present assets confirmed deleted on storage (excluding already-absent and failed assets).

5. Idempotent repeated recovery: recoverInstallations() returns resolution='GC_RETRY_PENDING', recovered=false, preserving narrowed retry state during persistent faults; transitions cleanly to COMPLETED_INTERRUPTED_GC on final success and NONE thereafter.

6. Active, pinned & mandatory rollback version protection: VERSION_IS_ACTIVE, VERSION_PINNED_BY_ACTIVE_REFS, and VERSION_IS_MANDATORY_ROLLBACK checks remain strictly enforced before GC starts, and GC_RECOVERY_PENDING prevents overlapping install/activate/rollback/remove operations from clobbering a pending GC retry journal.

7. Comprehensive regression coverage in c05_12_fix02_gc_delete_failure_and_durable_recovery covering one-shot backend deleteCommittedAsset EIO failure, persistent failures across multiple restarts, interrupted recovery (injectCrashDuringGc), already-absent vs silent-no-op deletion, and final verified cleanup.
